339-677-5223-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

719-4050-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-4050-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

4691-4971-7841.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4691-4971-7841.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Darksteel Angel.

2893-3470-4826-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-7913.notablePrerequisites: You control another Merfolk and/or Knight.
3532-4997-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and Knight you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

877-3081-3817-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

725-1432-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Selvala and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-6798-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

891-2843-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1563-3899-6633-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1308-1409-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3532-3594-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3678-6879-6903.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-6879-6903.description:
Play Rith's Grove.
When Rith's Grove enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Rith's Grove.
Resolve the Rith's Grove trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Rith's Grove from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-851-1270-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1270-3129.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1308-2457-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4659-5078-5202-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Efficient Construction and Forensic Gadgeteer trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Clue token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat.

152-2397-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-2397-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

4890-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Dack's Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Dack's Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
4890-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Dack's Duplicate.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Dack's Duplicate.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

710-2511-2730.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

478-804-2416-2821-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.

Animate Candelabra using Rise and Shine
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-3128-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Skullport Merchant.
When Skullport Merchant enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

501-1652-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
501-1652-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

586-3771-5256-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
586-3771-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4125-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4125-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3438-4552-5127.description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, causing Inkmoth Nexus to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Draconic Destiny by paying {1}{R}{R}, attaching it to Inkmoth Nexus.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3.

1110-2942-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to three times Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

703-2719-2896.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attaching Necromancy to Astral Dragon.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Necromancy tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, with at least one trigger targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the first Necromancy trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Astral Dragon, and not attaching Necromancy to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces due to Necromancy being a creature.
The Necromancy Aura creature token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to being an Aura that is unattached.
The Necromancy token leaves-the-battlefield ability triggers, as well as Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Necromancy trigger, causing you to sacrifce Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 4.

380-703-2047-2557.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating eight token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger from step 2, creating four token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

Umbral Mantle attached to Jenson.
Jenson does not have summoning sickness.
579-2816-3068.description:
Activate Jenson by paying {5} and tapping it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Jenson by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1689-3568-4067.description:
Pay {1} and tap Crystal Ball to draw 2 cards.
Discard a card to untap your mana source.
Tap the source, adding {1}.
Discard a card, untapping Crystal Ball.
Repeat.

1657-4320-4419.description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Martyr's Cause to prevent all damage to a creature.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Murderous Redcap returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter which cancel out.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
